visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with an extreme close-up of several ears of corn on a rotating mechanical grill. The kernels are heavily glazed with a bubbling, reddish-brown sauce. A small orange flame flickers underneath, licking the surface of one corn cob. (2) Two finished grilled corns, dark brown and textured with sauce, are held up by hands in the foreground against a clear blue sky and the ornate, colorful tiled roof of a traditional Taiwanese temple. (3) A wide shot shows the 'Guo Ji Stone Grilled Corn' stall on a street corner in Kaohsiung. The stall has a distinctive yellow and green striped awning. A silver scooter is parked in front of the dark interior. (4) Inside the stall, a middle-aged female owner wearing a pink face mask and a black apron over a striped shirt is talking on a white landline telephone while holding a pen over a notebook. (5) A hand reaches into a large plastic bin filled with raw yellow and purple pearl corn cobs, selecting one. (6) The owner uses a wooden brush to apply a thick brown sauce to the rotating corn on the grill. The setting is dimly lit inside the stall, contrasting with the bright street outside. (7) A single corn cob is shown rotating, transforming from bright yellow to a deep, caramelized brown. (8) Three grilled corns are held up in a fan shape by two hands. The background is a blurry street scene. (9) A close-up shows a bite taken out of the grilled corn, revealing the steaming yellow kernels inside the thick coating. (10) The owner is seen placing hot corn cobs into white and red branded paper bags. The stall's sign, featuring the brand name and price list, is shown prominently before a final wide shot of the stall.
